第758章 攻打泽阳城（第1页）
等抄那家士族的时候胡达才发现，他家私库中，竟然还藏着五百多副崭新的甲胄和兵器。
他们竟然到死也舍不得拿出来给那些乡勇团练用。
胡达见到这些东西，忍不住冷笑：“这样要是能守得住城就有鬼了。”
他其实很想顺势占下县衙，泽阳县要比清平县富庶的多。
可惜江尘让他劫后就走，以葛家庄为起点，至多也只能在清平渡口一带屯田。
原本泽阳县百姓耕种的田地，他还必须约束手下，不得半分侵扰，搜刮粮食，也只能劫掠县衙、士族、地主。
胡达费了不少功夫才弹压下那些像进城大索的手下，最终得粮一万七千石，也足以他们吃上好一阵了。
只在泽阳县内待了两天，他就退了出去，回到了自己的清平县。
他离开数日之后，郡城内便有大军过来剿匪。
所谓大军，实际也不过是两幢人马，外加征召过来的二千乡勇。
胡达觉得据城而守，他必定能守住县城。
随后就听说那些官兵一边来，一边沿路强征百姓服役。
他攻县城时秋毫无犯，可那些官兵到来，却践踏了不知多少田地。
粮草不足时，甚至割走青苗充作军粮。
胡达听得唉声叹气，最终朝旁边问了一句：“纪艾，你说你为什么非得让我们退出泽阳县城！可惜了那么多田地啊。”
这纪艾，是江尘特意送来的人，为人聪慧，这半年给胡达出了不少主意。
纪艾双手拢在袖子里，轻笑开口：“大当家觉得守住泽阳城，就能守住城外的田地吗？”

他当然知道自己手下的1万人马是什么货色。
淘去两成的老弱，两成的妇孺，剩下的青壮最多不到六千人。
这六千人，大多此前都是种地的农户，据城而守，或许还行
可要出了郭城，正面面对身披甲胄的官兵，恐怕就是一冲即溃。
纪艾继续开口：“若是我们强行占据泽阳城，那些官兵攻得越久，毁掉的田地越多，百姓的损失越大。”
就算官兵不毁掉那些青苗，若是真有大军过来，他恐怕也得坚壁清野了。
纪艾：“我们虽是劫掠，可与官兵所作所为一比，反倒得了民心，下次再攻泽阳城，大概就没什么阻力了。”
“所以，这次我们虽然退出泽阳城，实际上才是真的占下了泽阳城。”
胡达忍不住挠头：“这些你一开始就想到了？”
他感觉跟这些聪明人在一起，自己都变笨了。
纪艾苦笑摇头：“我也是听说那些官兵的所作所为，才想到这一层的。但县尊恐怕早就想到了，否则也不会勒令我们抢完就走。”
胡达连连点头：“对，尘哥肯定想到了，我们还是安心守着这清平寨吧。”

又是一年秋近，江尘在院中晒着暖洋洋的日光。
江岳小小的身子裹着一身宽松的粗布小棉袍，软发挽了个小发髻，一只手抓着廊下木柱。
江有林在他身后伸出两只手护着，轻声开口：“冬儿，松手，对，松手！”
江岳松开攥着廊下木柱的小手，两条小腿微微分开，脚尖试探着蹭了蹭地面，摇摇晃晃地迈出一步。
小小的身子不稳，上半身往前倾，两条胳膊高高张开，才迈出两三步，就脚下踉跄，身子猛地一晃。
可江尘在旁喊了一句：“爹，你老这样，他就学不会走路了！”

Chapter 758 Attacking Zeyang City (page 1)
When he raided the noble family, Huda discovered that there were more than 500 pairs of brand-new armors and weapons hidden in his private treasury.
Even to the point of death, they were reluctant to use it for those rural warriors to practice with.
When Huda saw these things, he couldn't help but sneer: "If the city can be defended like this, there will be ghosts."
He actually wanted to take advantage of the situation and occupy the county government. Zeyang County was much richer than Qingping County.
It's a pity that Jiang Chen asked him to leave after the disaster. Starting from Gejiazhuang, he could only farm in the Qingping Ferry area at most.
Originally, he had to restrain his men from intruding on the fields cultivated by the people of Zeyang County. He could only plunder the county government, nobles, and landlords when searching for food.
Huda spent a lot of effort to suppress the men who were like big ropes entering the city, and finally obtained 17,000 dan of food, which was enough for them to eat for a while.
After only staying in Zeyang County for two days, he withdrew and returned to his Qingping County.
A few days after he left, a large army came to suppress the bandits in the county.
The so-called army was actually just two troops, plus two thousand local warriors recruited.
Hu Da felt that if he stayed in the city and defended it, he would be able to defend the county seat.
Then I heard that those officers and soldiers were coming and forcing people to serve along the road.
He made no mistakes when he attacked the county town, but when those officers and soldiers arrived, they trampled on countless fields.
When food and grass were insufficient, young crops were even cut off to be used as army rations.
Huda sighed when he heard this, and finally asked to the side: "Ji Ai, tell me why you had to let us withdraw from Zeyang County! It's a pity that so many fields have been lost."
This Ji Ai was specially sent by Jiang Chen. He was a smart person and had given Huda a lot of ideas in the past six months.
Ji Ai put his hands in his sleeves, chuckled and said, "Do you think that by guarding Zeyang City, you can guard the fields outside the city?"
Of course he knew what his 10,000 troops were.
After removing 20% ​​of the old and weak, and 20% of the women and children, the remaining young and strong people were less than 6,000 at most.
Most of these 6,000 people were farmers before. It might be okay to stay in the city.
But when they leave Guocheng and face the armored officers and soldiers head-on, they will probably be defeated in a rush.
Ji Ai continued: "If we forcefully occupy Zeyang City, the longer those officers and soldiers attack, the more fields will be destroyed, and the greater the losses for the people will be."
Even if the officers and soldiers did not destroy the young crops, if a large army came over, he would probably have to fortify the walls and clear the country.
Ji Ai: "Although we were plundering, compared with what the officers and soldiers did, we won the hearts of the people. Next time we attack Zeyang City, there will probably be no resistance."
"So, although we retreated from Zeyang City this time, we actually captured Zeyang City."
Huda couldn't help scratching his head: "Did you think of these from the beginning?"
He felt like he was becoming stupid when he was with these smart people.
Ji Ai smiled bitterly and shook his head: "I only thought of this after hearing about what those officers and soldiers did. But I'm afraid the county magistrate had already thought of it, otherwise he wouldn't have ordered us to leave after robbing."
Huda nodded repeatedly: "Yes, Brother Chen must have thought of it. We should just guard Qingping Village with peace of mind."

Autumn is approaching again, Jiang Chen is basking in the warm sunshine in the courtyard.
Jiang Yue's small body was wrapped in a loose coarse cotton robe, his soft hair was pulled into a small bun, and he was holding on to the wooden pillar of the corridor with one hand.
Jiang Youlin stretched out his hands to protect him behind him and said softly: "Dong'er, let go, yes, let go!"
Jiang Yue loosened his little hand that was holding the wooden pillar under the corridor, and his two calves slightlyHe spread his legs slightly apart, tentatively rubbed the ground with his toes, and took a unsteady step.
His small body was unstable, his upper body leaned forward, and his arms were spread high. After taking two or three steps, he stumbled and his body swayed suddenly.
But Jiang Chen shouted from the side: "Dad, if you keep doing this, he won't be able to learn to walk!"
